positions.title: Networking Lead
positions.description:
University department dedicated to account support and networking troubleshooting.
•Assist in the inspection of over 100 data closets across 48 buildings ensuring cleanliness, climate control, security,and equipment integrity.
•Resolved 100+ tickets regarding complex account support or networking issues by using proprietary system administration tools.
•Utilised advanced tools such as LinkRunner or WireMapper to diagnose and repair physical cabling issues in network.

positions.title: IT Infrastructure Intern
positions.description:
· Automated publication of market data from Bloomberg to local data stream cutting update time by 90% on 100+ stocks and futures.  Created Data Domain Objects and other custom abstractions to accommodate future instrument measurements with Python3.  Tested to 100% code coverage with Pytest.
• Scripted PostgreSQL database cluster installatation, configuration, and deployment in 70+ clusters using Ansible.  Increased DB performance by 60% and cut deployment time by 200%.
• Wrote check in Icinga2 monitoring to validate Ubuntu and RHEL Linux network interface configuration.  Built custom parser for configuration files to reduce space overhead by 60% and deployment requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Start-up modernising construction through digitisation of construction sites using robotics and machine learning
•Developed Python script used internally to categorise and label 10.000+ point cloud object.

projects.title: Eazy Notes Text Summarisation
projects.description:
Web application designed to summarise lectures into readable text from audio.
•Built Django pipeline that took in audio files and outputted readable summarised text.
•Used Microsoft Azure tools to perform abstractive summarisation algorithms.
•Implemented hosting and maintenance on Heroku.
